# altertable_bucket (Data Source)

Look up a bucket by environment and ID or slug. Access keys are write-only and never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by slug…
data "altertable_bucket" "landing" {
  environment_id = altertable_environment.production.id
  slug           = "BKT-1"
}

# …or by ID
data "altertable_bucket" "archive" {
  environment_id = altertable_environment.production.id
  id             = "3b9f2e1d-8c7a-4f5b-a6d3-1e0c9b8a7f6e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Parent environment ID.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Bucket ID to look up. Exactly one of `id` or `slug` must be set.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe bucket slug (e.g. `BKT-1`) to look up. Exactly one of `id` or `slug` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `built_in` (Boolean) Whether this is the environment's built-in bucket.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `endpoint` (String) Custom S3-compatible endpoint URL.
- `name` (String) Bucket name in the storage provider.
- `region` (String) Bucket region.
- `storage_provider` (String) Storage provider derived from the endpoint: `s3`, `r2`, `gcs` or `custom`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
